description: Offline retrieval-recall corpus: lexical hits, semantic-only relevance, FTS sanitization, greeting skips, and briefing behavior. Review with the retrieval + one-call synthesizer against a configured model.

cases.query: Do we use tabs for indentation?
cases.notes: Exact tokens surface via the lexical retriever (FTS5).

cases.query: add a caching layer to the API

memories.text: User gets frustrated when abstractions appear before three call sites

cases.notes: No shared terms: the semantic retriever (MiniLM) must surface the memory and the model must judge it relevant.

cases.query: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
cases.notes: A query matching nothing returns zero candidates, never the least-bad memories.
FTS syntax characters and non-ASCII must produce candidates, never silently zero.
Greeting-only and trivially short queries skip retrieval entirely.
A no-source first turn renders no task-relevant section but still renders user preferences.

cases.query: what commit style do we use?

memories.text: Do not use emoji in commits

cases.notes: Mutating an uncited memory mid-call still produces the briefing; mutating a cited one fails closed with no content and no citation event.

cases.query: Review the changes in the last three commits and tell me what needs fixing; also write a test plan.

memories.text: Do not use emoji in commits

cases.notes: The briefing must produce only cited durable context and never echo task-execution language (could not perform, not provided, cannot access, claims about writing or reviewing files).
